message:
fix(workspace): search paths created through Dagger

A scoped Workspace.search sends every requested path to the host before
merging changes made through Dagger. A file created with withNewFile is
not on the host, so the host search fails before it can return that file.
The same issue affects new parent directories and mixed source lists.

Exclude paths covered by Dagger changes from the host search. Merge those
changes even when no host operands remain. Check the underlying source
when an edited child may have created its parent directory.

Add a real CLI integration test for the three failures and for preserving
errors on unrelated missing paths. Existing focused source-path and merge
tests pass under the race detector. No new shared state is needed.

Signed-off-by: Guillaume de Rouville <guillaume@dagger.io>
